BeltFixed_Cw.DisplayDesc: A conveyor belt powered by magic, streamlining automation in the alchemy industry.

BeltFixed_3Merge.DisplayDesc: A conveyor belt powered by magic, streamlining automation in the alchemy industry.

BeltSlopeUp.DisplayDesc: A conveyor belt that can send items to high or low places.

BeltSlopeDown.DisplayDesc: A conveyor belt that can send items to high or low places.

BeltInclinedUp.DisplayDesc: A conveyor belt that can send items to high or low places.

BeltInclinedDown.DisplayDesc: A conveyor belt that can send items to high or low places.

ConveyerLift_Upwards.DisplayDesc: A logistics device for transporting items vertically. Drag to adjust height. Can be switched to move items upwards or downwards.

ConveyerLift_Downwards.DisplayDesc: A logistics device for transporting items vertically. Drag to adjust height. Can be switched to move items upwards or downwards.

Catapult.DisplayDesc: A catapult that can throw items onto shelves or hopper conveyors, with angle and distance restrictions.

Hopper.DisplayDesc: Designed to catch thrown items, it features a single conveyor belt output.

Hopper2.DisplayDesc: Designed to catch thrown items, it features a single conveyor belt output.

Hopper2_2.DisplayDesc: Designed to catch thrown items, it features a single conveyor belt output.

Hopper4.DisplayDesc: Designed to catch thrown items, it features a single conveyor belt output.

Pipe.DisplayDesc: Pipeline for transporting liquids, configurable in vertical or horizontal mode.

Pipe_Vertical.DisplayDesc: Pipeline for transporting liquids, configurable in vertical or horizontal mode.

ConveyorTunnel.DisplayDesc: A conveyor passage that can be mounted on walls.

ConveyorTunnel_Sym.DisplayDesc: A conveyor passage that can be mounted on walls.

CrossTunnel.DisplayDesc: A conveyor tunnel that allows items to cross paths.

DrawBridge.DisplayDesc: A special conveyor belt pulled by linen ropes, requiring no extra support.

DrawBridgeR.DisplayDesc: A special conveyor belt pulled by linen ropes, requiring no extra support.

ExpandableDrawBridge.DisplayDesc: A hangable drawbridge conveyor adjustable in hanging height.

ExpandableDrawBridge_2.DisplayDesc: A hangable drawbridge conveyor adjustable in hanging height.

Filter_Vert.DisplayDesc: A splitter designed to filter out chosen items.

Filter.DisplayDesc: A splitter designed to filter out chosen items.

Filter_Sym.DisplayDesc: A splitter designed to filter out chosen items.

Splitter_Vert.DisplayDesc: Features one conveyor belt input and two conveyor belt outputs. Input items are prioritized for the first output.

Splitter.DisplayDesc: Features one conveyor belt input and two conveyor belt outputs. Input items are prioritized for the first output.

Splitter_Sym.DisplayDesc: Features one conveyor belt input and two conveyor belt outputs. Input items are prioritized for the first output.

Merger_Vert.DisplayDesc: Features two conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output. Items put into the first input are prioritized.

Merger.DisplayDesc: Features two conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output. Items put into the first input are prioritized.

Merger_Sym.DisplayDesc: Features two conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output. Items put into the first input are prioritized.

Cannon.DisplayDesc: An advanced catapult with no angle restrictions, longer throw distance, and two conveyor belt inputs.

ExpandableConveyorTunnel.DisplayDesc: A conveyor passage adjustable in length, with a maximum length of 10 tiles.

Balance.DisplayDesc: Features one conveyor belt input and two conveyor belt outputs. Input coins or raw materials are split evenly into the two outputs.

SmartCannon.DisplayDesc: Automatically identifies input materials and delivers them to the corresponding nearby shelves or Advanced Hoppers. Can be inverted.

SmartCannonCeiling.DisplayDesc: Automatically identifies input materials and delivers them to the corresponding nearby shelves or Advanced Hoppers. Can be inverted.

SmartHopper.DisplayDesc: A hopper that can be configured to request specific items.

TrackFilter.DisplayDesc: Routes matching wagons onto the branch track according to the configured filter rules.

TrackFilterSym.DisplayDesc: Routes matching wagons onto the branch track according to the configured filter rules.

TrackFilter2.DisplayDesc: Routes matching wagons onto the branch track according to the configured filter rules.

TrackFilter2Sym.DisplayDesc: Routes matching wagons onto the branch track according to the configured filter rules.

TrackStart.DisplayDesc: Charges wagons so they can travel through the rail network.

TrackEnd.DisplayDesc: Receives arriving wagons and unloads their cargo.

TrackUploader.DisplayDesc: Packages materials fed in by conveyor belts and loads them onto wagons. Has two conveyor belt inputs and can store up to four packages at a time.

TrackUploaderSym.DisplayDesc: Packages materials fed in by conveyor belts and loads them onto wagons. Has two conveyor belt inputs and can store up to four packages at a time.

TrackDownloader.DisplayDesc: Unloads and unpacks packages from wagons, then outputs the materials via conveyor belts. Wagon filter rules can be configured.

TrackDownloaderSym.DisplayDesc: Unloads and unpacks packages from wagons, then outputs the materials via conveyor belts. Wagon filter rules can be configured.

TrackTransfer.DisplayDesc: Transfers cargo between wagons on two tracks via a temporary storage platform. The platform can hold up to eight packages.

TrackTransfer_Reverse.DisplayDesc: Transfers cargo between wagons on two tracks via a temporary storage platform. The platform can hold up to eight packages.

TrackTransferSym.DisplayDesc: Transfers cargo between wagons on two tracks via a temporary storage platform. The platform can hold up to eight packages.

TrackTransferSym_Reverse.DisplayDesc: Transfers cargo between wagons on two tracks via a temporary storage platform. The platform can hold up to eight packages.

TrackTransferSym_Re_2.DisplayDesc: Transfers cargo between wagons on two tracks via a temporary storage platform. The platform can hold up to eight packages.

Grinder.DisplayDesc: Automated grinding device with one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

EnhancedGrinder.DisplayDesc: A more efficient grinder, working at twice the speed of a regular one.

Crucible.DisplayDesc: Automated heating device that can only be built on a furnace, with one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

StackableCrucible.DisplayDesc: An automated heater that transfers heat to the device above it.

Extractor.DisplayDesc: Automated extraction device with one conveyor belt input and one pipeline output.

ThermalExtractor.DisplayDesc: An advanced Extractor with an added heating module. The higher up it's built, the greater its output.

Refiner.DisplayDesc: An automated refining device with two conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output.

Refiner_Sym.DisplayDesc: An automated refining device with two conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output.

ParadoxCrucible.DisplayDesc: A passive heating device that can refine any material into oblivion essence. Different materials will take different amounts of time to refine.

SteamBoiler.DisplayDesc: Converts heat into high-pressure steam. Output rate is adjustable.

KnowledgeAltar.DisplayDesc: Breaks down items to extract alchemical knowledge and increase the Knowledge Level. Breaking down relics grants a large amount of experience.

Cauldron.DisplayDesc: A traditional alchemy device that takes any three materials and refines them into one unknown material. Some old alchemists still insist on using it.

AdvancedCauldron.DisplayDesc: A cauldron forged from pure silver. Less a tool than a mark of true mastery in the alchemical arts.

Processor.DisplayDesc: An advanced processing device that requires a recipe. It has one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

Processor_Sym.DisplayDesc: An advanced processing device that requires a recipe. It has one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

Kiln.DisplayDesc: An advanced heating device that requires a recipe. It can only be built on a furnace, with one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

Blender.DisplayDesc: An advanced Blender that requires a recipe. It has one conveyor belt input, one pipeline input and one conveyor belt output.

Assembler.DisplayDesc: An advanced processing device that requires a recipe. It has two conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output.

Assembler_Sym.DisplayDesc: An advanced processing device that requires a recipe. It has two conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output.

Alembic.DisplayDesc: An alembic that requires a recipe. It can only be built on a furnace, with one conveyor belt input, one pipeline input and one pipeline output.

Athanor.DisplayDesc: An advanced athanor with a chance of failure. It has two conveyor outputs, and failed products go through the second output.

Athanor_Sym.DisplayDesc: An advanced athanor with a chance of failure. It has two conveyor outputs, and failed products go through the second output.

AdvancedBlender.DisplayDesc: An advanced blender that requires a recipe. It has two conveyor belt inputs, one pipeline input and one conveyor belt output.

AdvancedBlender_Sym.DisplayDesc: An advanced blender that requires a recipe. It has two conveyor belt inputs, one pipeline input and one conveyor belt output.

AdvancedAlembic.DisplayDesc: An advanced alembic that requires a recipe. It can only be built on a furnace, with two conveyor belt inputs, one pipeline input and one pipeline output.

AdvancedAlembic_Sym.DisplayDesc: An advanced alembic that requires a recipe. It can only be built on a furnace, with two conveyor belt inputs, one pipeline input and one pipeline output.

Omni-Machine.DisplayDesc: An advanced processing device that requires a recipe. It has three conveyor belt inputs, one pipeline input and one conveyor belt output.

AdvancedAthanor.DisplayDesc: An upgraded Athanor. Add catalysts to adjust recipe outcomes. It is compatible with standard Athanor recipes; when using them, heat consumption remains the same as a standard Athanor.

Shaper.DisplayDesc: An advanced shaper that requires a recipe. It has six conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output, and the product is crafted gradually as materials are fed in.

AdvancedShaper.DisplayDesc: An advanced shaper that requires a recipe. It has five conveyor belt inputs, two pipeline inputs and one conveyor belt output, and the product is crafted gradually as materials are fed in.

AetherShaper.DisplayDesc: An advanced shaper that requires a recipe. It has nine conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output, and the product is crafted gradually as materials are fed in.

ArcaneProcessor.DisplayDesc: An advanced processing device that requires a recipe. It has one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

StoneStove.DisplayDesc: A simple heating device. After adding fuel, the devices above the stone furnace can be heated. Fuel can be automatically refilled through a conveyor belt.

StoneFurnace.DisplayDesc: An advanced heating device with a larger heating area. It can automatically refill fuel through a conveyor belt.

SteamHeater.DisplayDesc: A fuel-free heating station. Feed it steam to heat the equipment above.

WoodTable.DisplayDesc: A simple wooden table for displaying your Lab devices.

WorkBench.DisplayDesc: A workbench used to research and unlock new buildings and devices.

CheckoutTable.DisplayDesc: A checkout counter where customers complete their purchases. Install a Cashier to enable automatic checkout.

MediumStand.DisplayDesc: A shelf with two slots for displaying and selling sundries.

LargeStand.DisplayDesc: A shelf with three slots for displaying and selling sundries.

WoodCrate.DisplayDesc: A wooden box for stacking miscellaneous items — it might be a good alternative when a wooden table is too big.

WoodBed.DisplayDesc: A wooden bed you can sleep on until the next day — no overtime today.

PotionStand.DisplayDesc: A shelf with four slots for displaying and selling potions.

JewelryStand.DisplayDesc: A shelf with three slots for displaying and selling jewelries.

BrewBarrel.DisplayDesc: Blends different liquids into unique beverages, then serves the finished products to customers.

CoasterEntrance.DisplayDesc: Blends different liquids into unique beverages, then serves the finished products to customers.

AutoCheckout.DisplayDesc: A cashier with automatic checkout. It stops working when the coin limit is reached and features two conveyor belts.

RelicStandSmall.DisplayDesc: A shelf of adjustable size for displaying and selling relics.

ShrinkMachine.DisplayDesc: Harnesses the power of transmutation potions to reshape a human body into any item.

GrandPortal.DisplayDesc: A portal connecting distant cities, allowing customers from across the land to quickly reach the shop. Building more will not increase customer traffic.

Platform_Wood.DisplayDesc: A small platform half a floor high.

Stairs_Wood.DisplayDesc: A small staircase with the height of half a floor.

Construct_Floor_Wood.DisplayDesc: A modular wooden floor which can have its size toggled.

Construct_Floor_Wood_8x8.DisplayDesc: A modular wooden floor which can have its size toggled.

Construct_Wall_Wood.DisplayDesc: Modular wooden wall that can be switched to a form with a door or a window.

Construct_Wall_Wood_8x16.DisplayDesc: Modular wooden wall that can be switched to a form with a door or a window.

Construct_Wall_Stone_8x16.DisplayDesc: Modular wooden wall that can be switched to a form with a door or a window.

Wall_Wood_Tri.DisplayDesc: Modular wooden wall that can be switched to a form with a door or a window.

Roof_Wood.DisplayDesc: Weather-resistant shingles on a plank base. Simple assembly, full protection.

Roof_Wood_2.DisplayDesc: Weather-resistant shingles on a plank base. Simple assembly, full protection.

Construct_Wall_Stone.DisplayDesc: A modular stone wall that can be switched to forms with a door or a window.

WoodRailing.DisplayDesc: Wooden railing with sturdy structure and practical use.

WoodRailing_Half.DisplayDesc: Wooden railing with sturdy structure and practical use.

Construct_Floor_Brick_8x8.DisplayDesc: A modular wooden floor which can have its size toggled.

Construct_Wall_Brick_8x16.DisplayDesc: Modular wooden wall that can be switched to a form with a door or a window.

Wall_Brick_Tri.DisplayDesc: Modular wooden wall that can be switched to a form with a door or a window.

Construct_Floor_Marble_8x8.DisplayDesc: A modular wooden floor which can have its size toggled.

Construct_Wall_Marble_8x16.DisplayDesc: Modular wooden wall that can be switched to a form with a door or a window.

Wall_Marble_Tri.DisplayDesc: Modular wooden wall that can be switched to a form with a door or a window.

ShopEntrance.DisplayDesc: The entrance to the shop. Customers can only enter through a Shop Entrance.

Stairs_Wood_0.DisplayDesc: A wood staircase half a floor high.

Pillar.DisplayDesc: A steel-reinforced pillar that can provide support for the floors.

BounceShroom.DisplayDesc: A bouncy mushroom that can launch you high into the air after you step on it.

GrandStairs.DisplayDesc: A full-story solid wood grand staircase, featuring exquisite handrails and luxurious carpets.

Elevator_Bottom.DisplayDesc: The basic framework of a passenger lift. Drag while building to adjust its height.

Elevator_Station.DisplayDesc: A landing installed on a lift shaft. Operate the lever to call the lift.

TableSaw.DisplayDesc: It consumes Logs to produce planks, with one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

StoneCrusher.DisplayDesc: It consumes limestone to produce rubbles, and has one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

SeedPlot.DisplayDesc: A planting plot. After using plant seeds, you can wait to harvest.

IronSmelter.DisplayDesc: It consumes iron ore to smelt iron ingots and can only be built on a furnace and has a conveyor belt output.

AutoNursery.DisplayDesc: An automatic herbal production device. Spread seeds and add fertilizer to grow the corresponding herbs.

WorldTreeNursery.DisplayDesc: A Nursery used specially to grow a World Tree. It consumes Fertilizer at a set rate and has nine conveyor belt inputs and one conveyor belt output.

Portal_AlchGuild.DisplayDesc: A purchasing portal available only to senior members of the Alchemy Association. Input the required money to acquire the corresponding items.

Portal_Bank.DisplayDesc: A device used to convert back and forth between two different coins, with the ability to set the amount of coins output each time.

Portal_Wholesaling.DisplayDesc: A portal that can send goods to the purchaser and receive payment. The corresponding purchase contract must first be unlocked.

Portal_Output.DisplayDesc: A portal capable of outputting any items.

Portal_Input.DisplayDesc: A portal capable of receiving any item input.

Flask_Output.DisplayDesc: A flask capable of outputting any liquid.

Flask_Input.DisplayDesc: A flask capable of receiving any liquid input.

SmallContainer.DisplayDesc: A small storage box configurable in multiple modes, with one conveyor belt input and one conveyor belt output.

WoodContainer.DisplayDesc: Automated storage box with two conveyor belt inputs and two conveyor belt outputs.

JunkBarrel.DisplayDesc: A trash barrel with four conveyor belt inputs, emptied each night.

MetalContainer.DisplayDesc: A metal-reinforced advanced automated storage box with larger capacity.

ConicalFlask.DisplayDesc: A small Flask for liquids, with a pipeline input, switchable between a conical flask and a round-bottom flask.

RoundBottomFlask.DisplayDesc: A small Flask for liquids, with a pipeline input, switchable between a conical flask and a round-bottom flask.

SphereFlask.DisplayDesc: A spherical flask for storing liquids, with four pipeline connections.

FrameSingle.DisplayDesc: Essential laboratory stands for efficient production-line setup.

FrameDuo.DisplayDesc: Essential laboratory stands for efficient production-line setup.

IronStand.DisplayDesc: Essential laboratory stands for efficient production-line setup.

IronStandDuo.DisplayDesc: Essential laboratory stands for efficient production-line setup.

Beam3.DisplayDesc: An auxiliary structure that only needs to be supported on both ends to build and that can be converted to different lengths.

WallShelf.DisplayDesc: Wall-mounted support device that greatly improves space utilization.

MetalStand.DisplayDesc: Metal-framed laboratory stand with enhanced durability.

MetalStandEmpty.DisplayDesc: Metal-framed laboratory stand with enhanced durability.

MetalStand2.DisplayDesc: Metal-framed laboratory stand with enhanced durability.

MetalStand1.DisplayDesc: Metal-framed laboratory stand with enhanced durability.

SmallPlatform.DisplayDesc: A nailed wood-metal reinforced platform for production line expansion.

MediumPlatform.DisplayDesc: A nailed wood-metal reinforced platform for production line expansion.

CrossPlatform.DisplayDesc: A nailed wood-metal reinforced platform for production line expansion.

ExpandableBeam.DisplayDesc: A beam adjustable in length, with a maximum length of 10 tiles.

Candle.DisplayDesc: A simple lighting device that can be placed or wall-mounted.

NoticeBoard.DisplayDesc: A freely editable notice board that can be switched to a wall-mounted form.

NoticeBoard_2.DisplayDesc: A freely editable notice board that can be switched to a wall-mounted form.

Chandelier.DisplayDesc: A lighting device that can only be hung from the ceiling.

TreasureChest.DisplayDesc: A chest filled with gold and jewels, used to display immense wealth.

CharcoalBlock.DisplayDesc: A block that transfers heat vertically.

LeafBlock.DisplayDesc: A block containing the power of the World Tree which can be built even without any support.

CoreBlock.DisplayDesc: A block containing the power of the World Tree which can be built even without any support.

FreightElevatorFrame_Bottom.DisplayDesc: The basic framework of a cargo lift. Drag while building to adjust its height.

LiftUploader.DisplayDesc: Packages materials fed in by conveyor belts and loads them onto the cargo lift platform. Stores up to four packages at a time.

LiftDownloader.DisplayDesc: Unloads and unpacks packages from the cargo lift platform, then outputs the materials via conveyor belts.

LiftWagonUploader.DisplayDesc: Transfers packages from a wagon to the cargo lift platform. Stores up to eight packages.

LiftWagonUploaderSym.DisplayDesc: Transfers packages from a wagon to the cargo lift platform. Stores up to eight packages.

LiftWagonDownloader.DisplayDesc: Transfers packages from the cargo lift platform to a wagon. Stores up to eight packages.

LiftWagonDownloaderSym.DisplayDesc: Transfers packages from the cargo lift platform to a wagon. Stores up to eight packages.
